faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Z Image Turbo Image-to-Image

q1.question: How many images can I upload?
q1.answer: Z Image Turbo processes one image at a time. Upload your image, set size and strength, then generate.

q2.question: How much does it cost?
q2.answer: Each transformation uses a fixed number of credits. Check the generate button for the current cost.

q3.question: What image formats are supported?
q3.answer: We support PNG, JPEG, JPG, and WebP for input. Output can be JPEG, PNG or WebP.

q4.question: How detailed should my prompt be?
q4.answer: More detail generally means better results. Include subject, setting, lighting, style and what you want to preserve or change.

q5.question: What does strength do?
q5.answer: Strength (0–1) controls how much the image changes. Lower values keep more of the original; higher values allow more transformation.
